narration_timeline.text: What happens when a lion is not chasing prey? Even young cubs have a busy day.
narration_timeline.scene: Lion cubs playing and investigating a branch at Jacksonville Zoo.

narration_timeline.text: In the wild, cubs travel together, while adult lions can share long quiet moments.
narration_timeline.scene: Wild cubs walking in a group, then two adult male lions resting at a zoo.

narration_timeline.text: The youngest lions explore their surroundings and stay close to larger members of the pride.
narration_timeline.scene: Wild cubs and adult male with cubs; verify actual movements.

narration_timeline.text: Adults also spend time resting, grooming, and watching what happens around them.
narration_timeline.scene: Lioness visibly grooming/resting on grass at Botlierskop.

narration_timeline.text: When it is time to drink, even a powerful hunter lowers its head to the water.
Lions can even walk calmly past safari vehicles, still fully wild.
narration_timeline.scene: Lions walking beside safari vehicles in real footage.
